Join our Team
 About this opportunity:
 The Integration Engineer ensures high-quality, first-time-right delivery of Ericsson cloud infrastructure solutions for CN Cloud & Common customers. The role covers requirements analysis, configuration, implementation, validation and integration of Ericsson NFVI and Cloud Native Infrastructure (CNIS), including deployments, upgrades, migrations, expansions and related network/application functions.
The role follows Ericsson processes, group directives, E+OHS, information security and contractual requirements, ensuring smooth handover to operations and customer teams.
 Key Responsibilities
Execute deployments, upgrades, migrations and expansions for Ericsson Cloud Infrastructure according to approved design documentation.
Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues during deployment, integration and acceptance phases.
Coordinate with project stakeholders and cross-functional teams to integrate VNFs/CNFs, OSS/BSS and orchestration components.
Review customer requirements and design documentation, contributing to estimates, planning and delivery preparation.
Execute testing and acceptance activities and maintain key technical documentation, including LLD, ATP and MOP.
Act as technical interface with customers and Product Development Units, using tools such as JIRA and Salesforce to address product issues.
Drive improvements in methods, tools, automation and ways of working, sharing lessons learned with peers and junior engineers.
Ensure compliance with Ericsson processes, legal/financial directives, E+OHS, data security and privacy requirements. Availability for short business trips and overnight work may be required.
 Required skills:
Experience with Ericsson NFVI/CNIS or similar OpenStack, Kubernetes, virtualization or cloud-native platforms.
Strong knowledge of distributed cloud architectures, virtualization, container orchestration, software-defined networking/storage and infrastructure automation.
Experience with CNFs/VNFs and understanding of telecom network architectures.
Strong troubleshooting skills and ability to work in cross-functional, multi-country teams.
Proactive mindset, able to manage complex tasks independently and improve tools, automation and delivery practices.
Preferred technologies and vendors include: 
Ericsson NFVI/CNIS, Kubernetes and OpenStack platforms.
SDI/SDS, Ceph or equivalent compute, storage and networking solutions; HP/Dell hardware ecosystem.
IP networking, control/data plane architecture, data center fabric, switching and Kubernetes CNI concepts; Extreme SLX/EFA, Juniper or Cisco DC equipment.
Linux administration and troubleshooting on Ubuntu, RHEL, SUSE or CentOS.
Python/Bash scripting for automation, configuration and troubleshooting.
